svg.title: A sanctum serves who needs it
svg.desc: The Vale Sanctum asking "Who shall I revive?" with Garet and Mia down and Ivan poisoned. The hand can point at any member, but only one who needs the service can be chosen: on Ivan, who is not down, the priest says "This ally needs no healing." Each service has its own test and fee: reviving is for a member who is down and costs 20 coins a level; curing poison is for a poisoned member and costs 10 coins; exorcising is for a haunted member and costs 50 coins; removing a curse is for a member held by a cursed item and costs 10 coins a level.
svg.text: THE VALE SANCTUM: WHO SHALL I REVIVE?
The hand is on Ivan: poisoned, not down, so A only buzzes.
EACH SERVICE: WHO CAN BE CHOSEN, AND THE FEE
Fees in coins. Garet, at level 1, revives for 20.
